tool.name: Strands Agents
tool.description: Amazon-maintained open-source SDK and harness for building model-driven AI agents in Python and TypeScript.
strengths: Runs in-process, no hosted control plane
tool.practitionerNote: Natural choice for AWS shops that would otherwise hand-write an agent loop, while still allowing non-Bedrock providers. The repo is now a monorepo (strands-agents/sdk-python redirects to harness-sdk) with separate python/, harness-cli/ and mcp/ release tracks, so pin the package you actually use.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.

dataResidency.detail: Runs in the operator's own process with no hosted control plane; data placement follows the chosen model provider.

deployment.detail: OSS SDK embedded in the operator's application; no vendor SaaS required.

auditLogging.detail: Observability hooks are provided, but there is no built-in audit log; the operator implements logging.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted library; SOC 2 applies to the operator's infrastructure, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted library; ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted library; ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Developer component, not an AI system placed on the market; obligations rest with the deployer.
